suggestions.title: Self-test assumes the temp dir is outside any git repo; otherwise 3 cases fail and stub evidence lands in the real shared evidence root
suggestions.failurePath: fakeSkill() builds its throwaway skill under os.tmpdir() and assumes no git repository is above it (comment at lines 117-118). vp.mjs derives EVIDENCE_ROOT from mainCheckout(SCRIPT_ROOT) (vp.mjs:30, 95-105), and that function walks up to any enclosing repository. If TMPDIR sits inside a git checkout (some sandboxes or lane setups point TMPDIR at a project-local dir), the fake vp.mjs resolves that checkout's .claude/verify-evidence as its evidence root. Reproduced at the head with TMPDIR=<clone>/.tmp-in-repo. Result: 46/49, with FAIL on 'a case that needs real-llm needs --force...', 'cleanup reports the evidence root drive writes to' and 'archive --latest 1 copies the newest run only'. The run also left stub run directories (<stamp>-t-llm, <stamp>-t-out, <stamp>-t-ok) in that checkout's real .claude/verify-evidence. That is the shared root `archive --latest <n>` reads, so another lane could archive a stub. CI does not hit this, because tmpdir() is /tmp there and outside the checkout. Possible fixes: make fakeSkill `git init` its root so mainCheckout stops there, or have the test set an override that vp.mjs honours for the evidence root.
suggestions.evidence: vp-selftest.mjs:117-130 (fakeSkill: tempDir('vp-fake-'), evidenceRoot = join(root, '.claude', 'verify-evidence')); vp.mjs:30 `const EVIDENCE_ROOT = join(mainCheckout(SCRIPT_ROOT), '.claude', 'verify-evidence');` and vp.mjs:97 `git -C dir rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`. Local run: `TMPDIR=$PWD/.tmp-in-repo node .claude/skills/verify-pacman/scripts/vp-selftest.mjs` -> 46/49 passed, with 20261021-084335-t-llm, 20261021-084337-t-out and 20261021-084343-t-ok created under the checkout's .claude/verify-evidence.

I mutated vp.mjs so the refusal fires after the copy: drop the existsSync(dest) check from the plans map; in the copy loop, cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true}) with force left on, then fail('refusing to overwrite ... add-only', 1) when dest existed. The self-test passed 49/49 against that mutation, while run-a/result.json had been written into the archived directory. The case passed at 6f527a1 before any fix (vp-cli-3.txt). Also missing: a case where one --from source is new and one is already archived, checking that nothing is copied. Head code is correct today, because it checks every dest before copying. suggestions.title: --force for a stale or host-bound case also authorizes real-llm, github and rewrites-evidence without ever naming them
suggestions.failurePath: `vp.mjs drive local-daemon-executor mea-live-claude-code`: the status check at vp.mjs:199-202 runs before the forced-needs check at 203-207, so the refusal says only 'is host-bound: ... Re-run with --force to drive it anyway'. With --force, the needs check is skipped silently. The case has no `stack` need, so no doctor runs: vp prints 'writes its evidence itself: docs/verify/1259/' and immediately spawns drive-1259-mea-live.mjs. That probe mkdirs <repo>/docs/verify/1259 (lines 14-15) and writes screenshots and mea-live-result.json there (lines 27 and 150), rewriting committed evidence that ADR 0015 says is add-only. It also drives a real claude-code task. The same one-flag path applies to dual-source/dual-source (stale, github) and to skills-injection/native-plugin, skills-routing and skills-split (stale, real-llm). The consent the FORCE_NEEDS message exists to get is never asked for when the case is also non-current.
suggestions.evidence: vp.mjs:199-207. Registry entry for local-daemon-executor/mea-live-claude-code: status host-bound; needs remote-host, daemon, real-llm, rewrites-evidence; evidence {writes: docs/verify/1259/}. drive-1259-mea-live.mjs:14 `const EVIDENCE = join(REPO, 'docs/verify/1259')`. Suggested fix: append the forced needs and their reasons to the status refusal, or require a separate flag for FORCE_NEEDS.

suggestions.title: New required-CI self-test lives under .claude/skills/, outside ADR 0021 D4's enumerated protected paths
suggestions.failurePath: This PR makes `.claude/skills/verify-pacman/scripts/vp-selftest.mjs` a step of the required `check` job. The pass/fail logic lives in vp-selftest.mjs, and it reads vp.mjs, vp-registry.json and every registered probe. D4, as drafted on #1410, lists `.github/**`, `scripts/*gate*`, `scripts/check-*` and a few named scripts, but no path under `.claude/skills/`. Once #1410 lands, a later agent PR in an `autonomous` project could weaken a case in vp-selftest.mjs (for example the per-call machineId check) or flip a registry status to current. It would touch no D4 path, so it would not be forced to human: the 'agent changes the gate to pass it' failure the ADR's premortem names. This PR itself is forced to human by `.github/**` and its size, so it is not affected.
suggestions.evidence: ci.yml:137-138 `run: node .claude/skills/verify-pacman/scripts/vp-selftest.mjs` in the check job. The D4 row of the ADR 0021 copy on #1410 (line 37) contains no .claude/skills path. Suggested fix: add vp-selftest.mjs and vp-registry.json (or .claude/skills/verify-pacman/scripts/vp*.mjs) to D4's list or to the merge gate's path matcher when #1410 lands.
